editorial.blurb: Jam 'n Honey is a cozy neighborhood brunch spot serving hearty American fare with surprisingly quality ingredients—worth the trip for their generous portions and fresh-baked French toast.
editorial.insiderTip: Come prepared with cash or use their in-house ATM, and arrive early to secure a table in this tight but inviting space; outdoor seating is available on nice days.

topDishes.note: Generous, filling, and made with quality guacamole and fresh ingredients
Made on brioche with delicious results when prepared well
Well-executed brunch classic that lands solidly with diners
